checks.ref:
command:. .gnomish/lib/task-change.sh
since=$(git log --format='%H %s' | awk '$2 == "gnomish:" && $3 == "round" && $4 !~ /^fix-specs#/ { print $1; exit }')
start=$(git log --format='%H %s' | awk '$2 == "gnomish:" && $3 == "task" && $4 == "started" { print $1; exit }')
[ -n "$since" ] || since=$(git rev-parse "$start^" 2>/dev/null || git merge-base HEAD origin/main)
review="$reports/review-specs.md"
hunks=$(git diff -U0 "$since" -- "$review" | grep -E '^[-+]' | grep -vE '^(---|\+\+\+) ' || true)
removed=$(printf '%s\n' "$hunks" | grep -E '^-' | grep -vxF -- '-- Status: open' || true)
added=$(printf '%s\n' "$hunks" | grep -E '^\+' | grep -vE '^\+(- Status: |- Resolution: |  +[^ ])' || true)
[ -z "$removed$added" ] || { printf '%s\n' "$removed" "$added" | grep .; echo "only the '- Status:' lines and the new '- Resolution:' lines (continuation lines indented) of $review may change - restore the rest with: git checkout $since -- $review, then re-apply the statuses"; exit 1; }

findings.message: R1's resolution introduces a new glossary term, **Offset-only zone** (tasks.md task 2.2: 'a zone of the `Etc` area such as `Etc/GMT+5` ... *Code:* `ETC_ZONE_AREA`'; no such entry exists in docs/glossary/), but proposal.md 'What Changes' (line 21, the Glossary bullet listing the new `zone-rules` context terms **zone rules**, **zone rules release**, **cutoff**, **local time type**, **future rule**, **zone rules wrapper**, **zone rules compiler**, **zone rules check**) does not list it. .claude/rules/glossary.md requires: 'For an OpenSpec change, list new or changed terms in `proposal.md` ("What Changes"), add a task for the glossary entries in `tasks.md`, and use only glossary terms in specs and Gherkin.' Add **offset-only zone** to that bullet.
